tools.name: get_component_context
tools.description:
The primary tool. Calls Storybook MCP + Figma MCP in parallel and returns one unified ComponentContext JSON.

Accepts a full Figma URL (paste it directly) OR separate figmaNodeId + figmaFileKey.

Storybook source is automatic:
- If your Storybook MCP is running → connects to it
- If not → uses built-in fallback that reads local .stories.* files

Examples:
  get_component_context({})  ← requires figmaUrl or figmaNodeId
  get_component_context({ figmaUrl: "https://www.figma.com/design/ABC/Name?node-id=1-2" })
  get_component_context({ figmaUrl: "...", storybookTool: "get_story", storybookArgs: { componentName: "Button" } })
  get_component_context({ figmaNodeId: "1:2", figmaFileKey: "ABC123" })

figmaUrl.description: Full Figma design URL — paste directly from Figma (e.g. https://www.figma.com/design/ABC/Name?node-id=1-2)

figmaNodeId.description: Figma node ID (e.g. '1:2'). Use figmaUrl instead when possible.

figmaFileKey.description: Figma file key. Use figmaUrl instead when possible.

storybookTool.description: Storybook MCP tool to call. Defaults to 'get_all_stories_metadata' (built-in) or auto-detected from your Storybook MCP. Use list_storybook_tools to discover options.

storybookArgs.description: Arguments for the Storybook MCP tool

includeTokens.description: Fetch Figma design tokens (colors, spacing, typography). Default: true.
